Date 6/8/16

Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

August 5th 1916

Sir,
It was rumoured last evening that some of the
persons who were responsible for the big fire in Hankow
had arrived here and that they had succeeded to discontent
ex-revolutionary soldiers in Wondatown to burn and
loot the City and Chapel. It was said that the latter
had agreed to the suggestion and that they decided to
start last night. Special precautions were taken in
Chinese territory but nothing happened.
It is reported that considerable difference of
opinion exists among local republicans and that
they are likely to split up into different parties.
General Yang has reinstated four of the detectives
whom he dismissed a few weeks ago.
Sun Yat Sen is trying to raise funds to repatriate
men who have been in the employment of the rebels in
Frenchtown and who are at present without resources.
The Chinese Minister of Justice Chang Shih Tsai
and the Parliamentary representative of Yunnan who are
on their way to Peking arrived by the French Mail
steamer Athos on 5th. They were met by the
Tientsin's representative and went to the Nan Yu Li Kwo
Hotel at 184 Nanch Road.

Your obedient Servant,

（签名）5/8 O.K
McLusky
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police

日期 16/8/6

上海工部局。

（印：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探股）

1916年8月5日

先生：

昨晚有谣言称，一些对汉口大火负责的人员已抵达此地，并成功煽动万得城（Wondatown，音译）心怀不满的前革命士兵焚烧和抢劫城区及教堂。据说后者已同意该建议，并决定于昨晚行动。在华界地区已采取特别预防措施，但未发生任何事件。

据报道，当地共和派人士之间存在严重意见分歧，他们可能会分裂成不同党派。

杨将军已恢复几周前被他解职的四名侦探的职务。

孙中山正试图筹集资金，以遣返那些曾在法租界受雇于反叛者、目前身无分文的人员。

中国司法总长章士钊及云南国会议员代表在前往北京途中，于5日乘坐法国邮船“阿托斯”号（Athos）抵达。他们由天津代表迎接，随后前往位于南京路184号的南洋旅馆（Nan Yu Li Kwo Hotel，音译）。

您顺从的仆人，

（签名）5/8 核准
麦克拉斯基（McLusky）
首席侦探督察

警务处总监
